tasks.objective: Backlog topic repo-path-audit, the lows of the plans check. Add mutation cases to the portable-plans case: both punctuation forms rejected, both URL forms allowed; keep every existing case. Changelog fragment changelog.d/path-audit-pattern.md (### Fixed). tasks.objective: Backlog topic repo-path-audit, the audit. The maintainer rule (2026-11-06): nothing the flow needs may live only on one machine; today only docs/plans is checked. Add a read-only check scripts/checks/portable-paths.py (shape of scripts/checks/english-only.py: report by default, `--enforce` exits 1 on a finding, `path:line: match` output) over the tracked text files of the repo outside docs/plans (docs, skills, commands, agents, registry fragments and registry.json, README.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills, evals, testlab docs and fixtures, scripts and tests). It flags a user-specific path: a user home with a user name (the Windows Users directory in drive, Git Bash and WSL spellings, the Linux home directory, the macOS Users directory), an expanded Windows application-data path, and a machine-only scratch root (for example a drive-letter `tmp` directory such as the one in docs/architecture/ui-figma-real-test.md). It allows: environment-variable forms (a percent-wrapped Windows variable, `$HOME`, `~`), the registry workspace default and its platform spellings (read `workspace.root_default` from registry.json, never hard-code it), obviously fake names (`person`, `example`, `user`, `<name>` placeholders, the CI runner short name in .github), URLs, and an allowlist file with one reason per entry (tests/fixtures/portable-paths-allow.txt). Fix every finding: scrub the real user name in testlab/tests/fixtures (ad_trace_sessions.txt, failsum/*/results.json) to an obviously fake one without breaking testlab's tests (check which assertions read those values), and rewrite the provenance paragraph of docs/architecture/ui-figma-real-test.md (section about the run host) without machine paths. Register in tests/run-all.sh next to the English-only lines: a suite tests/portable-paths.test.sh (fixture cases: each flagged form found, each allowed form not, the allowlist works, `--enforce` exit codes) and `python3 -B scripts/checks/portable-paths.py --enforce`; list the suite in tests/README.md and the check in scripts/README.md. Changelog fragment changelog.d/path-audit-check.md (### Added). Keep it fast (one pass over `git ls-files`). CI runs on Linux: no test may depend on host tools of this Windows machine.
acceptance: scripts/checks/portable-paths.py --enforce exits 0 on the repo and 1 on each flagged fixture form
the registry workspace default, environment-variable forms, fake names and URLs are allowed
no tracked file outside the allowlist carries a real user home, expanded application-data or machine-only scratch path
run-all runs the suite and the enforce line; testlab's own tests still pass with the scrubbed fixtures

tasks.objective: CI of the plan's pull request failed in two suites because of scripts/checks/portable-paths.py (task user-path-check, integrated; its task QA never ran). Every script with a `__main__` block reconfigures stdout and stderr to UTF-8; copy the block of scripts/checks/english-only.py (the `_stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")` loop and the error handler that prints `portable-paths: error: ...` and exits 2). (b) tests/workspace-default.test.sh: 'workspace reader guard' forbids the registry key name of the workspace default in any Python file under scripts except scripts/lib/workspace.py and scripts/lib/fstate.py, and forbids calling `default_workspace()` outside scripts/lib. Add a unit case for the helper to the suite that covers workspace.py helpers (tests/workspace-default.test.sh) if it fits in a few lines. No new changelog fragment (the check is unreleased; changelog.d/path-audit-check.md already describes it). CI runs on Linux.
